number_sources.context: Planning your travel with a fantasy book conventions 2027 reader guide starts with one honest question: do you want an intimate hotel weekend where every single panel and dealer table speaks your exact subgenre, a massive international science fiction and fantasy literary gathering, or a sprawling multi-hotel pop-culture festival with dedicated fantasy book tracks?

Three standout events belong on every fantasy reader's 2027 calendar: LitRPG Con in Denver, the 2027 Worldcon in Montréal, and Dragon Con in Atlanta. Every date and venue below was verified against official event announcements on October 18, 2026. Because 2027 guest rosters and signing schedules are still being announced, check each official site for live updates before locking in non-refundable flights.

Choosing the right scale up front prevents booking a 50,000-person cosplay spectacle when you really wanted quiet hallway chats about progression magic systems.

number_sources.context: ## Why should progression fantasy and LitRPG readers circle LitRPG Con 2027 in Denver?

LitRPG Con 2027 gives readers three days dedicated specifically to LitRPG, progression fantasy, and game-lit books under one hotel roof. According to the [official LitRPG Con site]() (checked October 18, 2026), the convention runs July 9–11, 2027 at the Grand Hyatt in Denver.

LitRPG Con also runs on ConRoster, the convention platform built for gaming, fan and book conventions. At LitRPG Con 2026, about 600 app users logged 1,135 quest completions from 223 users and about 16,000 schedule shares. For readers, that means the convention app connects author panel listings directly to their dealer hall signing booths and displays author pages populated with books, covers, and series data from [LitRPG Tools]()—plus offline schedule caching and QR quests between sessions. (Check the [official LitRPG Con site]() as 2027 guest announcements and signing rules go live.)
## What makes Montréal Worldcon 2027 a strong choice for traditional SFF readers?

Montréal Worldcon 2027 is the 85th World Science Fiction Convention, offering five days of broad science fiction and fantasy panels, pitch sessions, and the Hugo Awards. According to the [official Worldcon announcement]() (checked October 18, 2026), it takes place September 2–6, 2027 at the Palais des Congrès de Montréal and surrounding hotels.

## How should fantasy readers weigh Dragon Con 2027 against the Labor Day overlap?

Dragon Con 2027 runs September 2–6, 2027 in downtown Atlanta according to the [official Dragon Con site]() (checked October 18, 2026)—the exact same Labor Day weekend as Montréal Worldcon. Choose Dragon Con if you want fantasy and urban fantasy book panels surrounded by massive cosplay, gaming halls, and late-night fan tracks.
